correctness.rationale: Binary hare sorts each block; every output is a product of c+1 sorted binary blocks followed by c twos, giving at most c descents. Cutting at all descents constructs every permitted output. Exact run-composition counting gives the binomial formula, a sharp cutoff, and the rational multivariate series. A Myhill–Nerode witness proves nonregularity; singularity analysis gives the growth constant. verify_exhaustive.py checks every input/output up to length ten and every content, while verify_independent.py checks forty lengths using unrelated counter-state recurrence; proofs cover all lengths.
